$comment: Electron port, release build. Same machine and method as baseline-tauri.json. Reproduce with `bun run package:deb && bun run package:appimage`.

frontend.$comment: Unchanged by the port. vite/mesh-optimize.ts still transcodes 114 MB of source meshes to 12 MB of Draco GLB.

rust.$comment: 556 -> 180 packages after dropping tauri/wry/webkit2gtk/gtk/objc2. The zigbuild target is load-bearing: a plain cargo build on 24.04 needs GLIBC_2.34 and will not start on Ubuntu 20.04.

deb.$comment: Not comparable to Tauri's 11.9 MB deb, which depends on system libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0 and is uninstallable on Ubuntu 20.04 (which ships 4.0).

appimage.$comment: The fair comparison: Tauri's self-contained AppImage is 86391288 bytes, so this is +12%.

runtime.$comment: PSS is the honest figure for multi-process Chromium. windowMs is not directly comparable to Tauri's: this shell waits for ready-to-show, Tauri maps an empty window immediately.

verification.packagedAppLaunch: daemon listening + renderer connected over loopback

notMeasured: GPU/WebGL frame rate: container is headless with software GL, so any number would describe llvmpipe rather than WebKitGTK vs Chromium. This is the largest expected win and it is unverified.
snap and flatpak packages: snapcraft needs snapd and flatpak-builder needs flathub, which this environment's egress policy blocks. Built in CI.
Runtime install-and-launch on Ubuntu 20.04/22.04/24.04: Docker Hub blob CDN is blocked here. Verified statically via ELF symbol analysis; the release workflow runs the real matrix.
